title: Migrate all branch policy, repository policy, and approvalsandchecks resources to terraform-plugin-framework
essence: 20 SDKv2 resources (7 branch policy, 7 repository policy, 6 approvalsandchecks/checks) are now served by the mux provider via terraform-plugin-framework. Live acceptance tests ran (TF_ACC=1): TestAccBranchPolicy*, TestAccRepositoryPolicy*, TestAccCheck* — all passed. Live evidence captured at 2026-07-03T01:25:01Z: ADO REST GET of check_approval configuration (id=80) confirmed existence post-apply at dev.azure.com/_apis/pipelines/checks/configurations.
